name: council
description: MCP server running structured, bounded critique rounds between Claude Code and Codex

scripts.install-skills: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills/council" "$HOME/.codex/skills/council" "$HOME/.claude/skills/plan-council" "$HOME/.codex/skills/plan-council" "$HOME/.claude/skills/impl-council" "$HOME/.codex/skills/impl-council" "$HOME/.codex/skills/verify-implementation" && cp skills/claude/SKILL.md "$HOME/.claude/skills/council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/codex/SKILL.md "$HOME/.codex/skills/council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/plan-claude/SKILL.md "$HOME/.claude/skills/plan-council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/plan-codex/SKILL.md "$HOME/.codex/skills/plan-council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/impl-claude/SKILL.md "$HOME/.claude/skills/impl-council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/impl-codex/SKILL.md "$HOME/.codex/skills/impl-council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/verify-implementation/SKILL.md "$HOME/.codex/skills/verify-implementation/SKILL.md" && echo 'skills installed to ~/.claude and ~/.codex'
